notes.title: Soul Reaper 1.2 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow reaper of souls!

We just released Soul Reaper version 1.2. This is part of our monthly update.

Here's what you can expect:

[h2]Soulless monsters[/h2]
1.2 doubles the number of monsters that were previously in the game for a total of 164 monsters. Soulless monsters are variations of the current monsters but with more potential. They have higher stats and have upgraded abilities. They are meant to help you defeat the stronger monsters more easily. They are also meant to bridge the gap in power between the (very strong) Soul Reaper and regular monsters.

You can obtain them in two ways:
[olist]
[*]By trading a level 200 soul. You'll get the soulless version of that soul (though at level 1) as well as a unique legendary loot to buff it up even further.
[*]By defeating them in the challenging fights (see below). The chance of reaping them is much lower than regular monsters, but they're that good, so it's worth it. Also, the Soul Find attribute does increase your chances of getting it. Don't be afraid to go over 100%.
[/olist]

Here's what a full squad of them may look like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/f04ac1f840f25515e5d65d18ad17b0094a8e42e2.png[/img]

[h2]9 new challenging fights[/h2]
What good is adding that many monsters if you can't fight them, right? We thought so too! We've added 9 new challenging fights in the Moon's menu, under the "Soulless Army" section. These guys are tough. Like, real tough. 

If you succeed in defeating the squad named Godly Lieutenants, please let us know what strategy you used to do it at info@powerlevelstudios.com. We found a few strategies to make it work, but we're intrigued to see what the community comes up with too.

Here is a screenshot to give you an idea of what the new challenges are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/e584d90c59515480bdc01a93842fc63c968e8bb4.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
We'll do more bug fixing in future updates, but for this one, we've fixed some bugs regarding the monster and soul attributes. Some of them were not giving you exactly what it said. For example, the Bermutilator was showing that it was doing damage to all monsters at max level when it really was doing damage to two columns only.

We hope you enjoy this update!

Thank you for playing!

Happy reaping!

notes.title: Soul Reaper is out of Early Access!!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow reaper of souls!

The day has come! Soul Reaper is now out of Early Access! 

After 7 months of testing on Early Access and 2 months of beta, Soul Reaper is finally ready to open its vault to fellow reapers of souls!

Here's what you can expect from the game at a glance:
[list]
[*] Zelda-style exploration (top-down 2D view)
[*] Pokemon-style monster catching mechanics
[*] Diablo-style loot system
[*] Final Fantasy-style combat (no random encounters)
[*] Path of Exile-style socketing
[*] Disgaea-style number crunching
[*] Unique 3x3 grid party system
[/list]

As for playtime, here's what you can expect:
[list]
[*] First playthrough: 20 hours
[*] New Game Plus: 35 hours
[*] All Steam achievements: 45 hours
[*] Complete all feats: 80 hours
[*] Defeat all special bosses: 100-200 hours
[/list]

We also have content patches planned for the following 6 months. Generally, you can expect more loot, new soul gears, new bosses, and new vault sections. 

On October 30th, you can expect:
[list]
[*] The Samurai loot set
[*] New soul gears
[*] Tons of new Steam Achievements
[*] New bosses from the Moon's menu
[/list]

Generally, if you love old-school (j)RPG, you'll love Soul Reaper. 

And if you're thrown off by the minimal number of reviews, it's only because we're a small indie studio with a minimal marketing budget. If you play the game and love it, it would greatly help us and other gamers discover it.

Happy reaping!

See you in the vault!

- Danny, Producer

notes.title: Soul Reaper's official release - play it soon!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow reaper of souls!

The official release is finally around the corner! The Steam Early Access period has given us plenty of feedback to work from and you'll find this official version to be a lot more complete and more bug-free. We're aiming for a September 30th launch date with a playable version available in the "beta" branch as early as August.

If you love monster-collection, deep strategy, complex loot/attribute systems, min/maxing your parties, and a solid Metroidvania-style exploration system, you're going to LOVE Soul Reaper! This new version brings everything to the next level. It really is a love letter to fans of Pokemon, Zelda, Diablo, Disgaea, Final Fantasy, and Castlevania.

If you've never played Soul Reaper before, the update notes below won't mean much to you, but know this: it's an epic update! It contains tons of new content & features and tons of bug fixes!

And if you're wondering if there's enough content for your money, here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Finishing the game once: 15-20 hours
[*] Finishing the game on New Game Plus: 25-30 hours
[*] Obtaining all the feats and achievements: 100-200 hours
[*] Defeating all the "uber" bosses: 200+ hours
[*] Maxing "everything": 300+ hours
[/list]

And that's only on launch day. New content will be added monthly for six months following the release, and likely beyond that as well.

Stay tuned for more updates closer to mid-August! Anyway, here are the update notes:

Happy reaping!

---

[h1]Story[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Added 8 new endings (see previous announcement for more details)[/b]
[*][b]Two special final boss fights with new combat mechanics (surprise, surprise!)[/b]
[*][b]Added new dialogues in the Void and in the intro scene[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Monsters in your party don't auto-attack anymore (you can turn this on/off)[/b]. This allows you to select the action you want to use when equipped with other souls on a monster's loot. Fights can be more strategic this way.
[*]Toned down the cursor particles.
[*]Highlighting monster on their turn to better see who's taking action currently.
[/list]

[h1]Vault[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Enemies don't respawn anymore after using regular teleporters (they still do when using waypoints)[/b]. This has been done to minimize frustration when backtracking to find the path you're looking for. See "Void" section next for a new method for farming monster souls.
[/list]

[h1]Void[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Completely new "Gauntlet" section[/b]. Allows you to instantly re-fight any squads you've previously encountered in the vault (this is by far a superior method for farming compared to rushing in the Vault)
[*][b]20 new challenging bosses in the "Gauntlet"[/b]. These will test your squad and combat planning. Some of them are much tougher than any of the final bosses.
[/list]

[h1]Main Menu[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]New Soul Gear "help" menu in the settings[/b].
[*][b]New Loot Artifacts "help" menu in the settings[/b].
[*]Minor UI updates to support different resolutions.
[*]Display of traits in the monster details panel (see below for more on traits).
[/list]

[h1]Monster/Souls[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Monsters now have "traits"[/b]
[*]Each monster has 1-5 traits.
[*]There are 30 different traits in total (like "furry", "edible", "heavenly", etc.).
[*]Monsters can be made stronger with loot that enhances stats for monsters that have specific traits. See new attributes from the "Game Balancing" section below.
[/list]

[h1]Game Balancing[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]All monsters now have 2x more health[/b].
[*][b]140+ new attributes to roll on loot or in Soul Gear (in three groups)[/b].
     1. Soul Amplification: Amplify effectiveness of a specific soul's ability (like the Balboa Fist already did in the previous versions)
     2. Trait Effectiveness Amplification: Amplify effectiveness of ability for monsters who have a specific trait (For example: Furry monsters deal 100% more damage)
     3. Trait Stats Amplification: Amplify Health and Agility for monsters who have a specific trait (For example: Flying monsters have +100 Health and +10 Agility)
[*][b]Rebalanced row bonuses using the new attributes from above (each monster now has a unique row bonus)[/b]. Check back your current squads as they might behave differently after this change. We'll avoid big changes like that as much as possible post-release.
[*]Fixed discrepancies between row bonuses and socketed bonuses on some monsters
[*]Fixed tons of imbalance issues in socketed bonuses
[/list]

[h1]Loot[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]80+ new unique loot[/b]
     - Themed after each monster
     - Obtainable by smithing level 200+ souls
[*][b]Gloves and boots can now have 2 soul sockets (up from 1)[/b]
[*][b]Gloves and boots now have 30 new Soul Gears each[/b]
     - "Gloves" Soul Gear amplify the effectiveness of abilities from monsters of a specific trait (see "Game Balancing" above)
     - "Boots" Soul Gear amplify the Health and Agility from monsters of a specific trait (See "Game Balancing" above)
[/list]

[h1]Smithing[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Smith level 200+ souls to get unique legendary loot (based on the loot you smith)[/b]
[*]Added an indicator that your inventory is full
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

[list]
[*]New Steam Achievements (final number TBD)
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]

[list]
[*]We added the ability to add new content and rebalance the game without the need for a full update on Steam (this will greatly accelerate the addition of new content and patches in the future)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h2]Blockers/major[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed most issues with computer language not set to "English" (if the game behaves strangely at the start, try switching your computer to "English" to see if that fixes it)
[*]Fixed soft-lock when talking to Sleepy Reaper with Romantic Reaper Fragment
[*]Fixed getting blocked by a black screen when entering combat while teleporting
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed some menus not scrolling far enough (devouring souls, smithing souls and smithing loot)
[*]Fixed monster some monster animations when soul smithing
[*]Fixed mini-map display errors on some maps
[*]Fixed Fournicorns sometimes running backwards towards you (byebye "moonwalking" animation :))
[*]Fixed movement pattern getting reset on teleport
[*]Fixed Reefraf being visible on respawn
[*]Fixed Reefraf and Stabbytabby not scaling in difficulty in New Game Plus
[*]Fixed "Deal Dark Damage" feat not registering
[*]Fixed loot not having the right number of attributes based on their rarity
[*]Fixed incorrect tiles in Polarus
[*]Fixed Polarus 9 (Icy Road) not having proper monster squads
[*]Fixed other visual glitches on the above map
[*]Fixed smithing menu not always updating after smithing loot or souls
[*]Fixed NG+ always starting from the second save file
[*]Fixed Devil Armor missing image
[/list]

[h1]Regression[/h1]

[list]
[*] We don't fully support game controllers anymore (though most of the game still works with a controller)
[/list]

notes.title: Putting Pen To Paper - Crafting Soul Reaper's Narrative
notes.notes:
Salutations, Reapers! It's been about a month since we've last spoken, and this Stabbytabby has been hard at work running around The Vault. I've been researching the lore behind my home, and managed to land a few interviews with the local wildlife… Well, at least with the souls I know that [i]won't[/i] try to destroy me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/5af8d659b8bd08a62ff45e7b093099b4e1ce931a.jpg[/img][i]There's a lot of fascinating people to meet around here! I even stumbled upon some folks in The Void recently… It's a little intimidating to be there![/i]

With my cunning cat detective skills, my reconnaissance has proven useful in the pursuit of writing the remaining endings for Soul Reaper.

Yup, that's correct! Not only do we have the scripts written and finalized for the remaining endings, but we also have a few new narrative pieces written as well! Here's a list of the scenes we currently have dialogue for!

*Please be aware that [b]some of the following content will contain minor spoilers[/b], so if you'd like to keep the new scenes a complete surprise, you'll want to skip over these next few sections!*

[h3]Single Soul Fragment Endings[/h3][list][*][b]Romantic Reaper Ending.[/b] Our hero tries (and fails) to ask the Herald out on a date, and things get a little weird from there…
[*][b]Sleepy Reaper Ending.[/b] The Herald's intimidation proves useless as our hero fails to keep his eyes open. In a sleepy haze, the Soul Reaper starts confusing his foe with otherworldly creatures.
[*][b]Greedy Reaper Ending. [/b]Things get off to a rocky start when the Soul Reaper claims that the Herald must somehow be related to the Jackoclops. Later, the Herald's combat strategy is eventually called into question.
[*][b]Angry Reaper Ending.[/b] Upon witnessing the Herald's floating orbs, our hero relegates his foe to the title of "Ball Boy." After a heated exchange with Caps Lock enabled, the Herald starts fighting fire with fire.
[*][b]Hungry Reaper Ending.[/b] The Herald is mistaken as an employee of "Floating Dude Fast Food." After receiving terrible service, the Soul Reaper demands to see his manager.
[/list]
These endings will follow closely in line with the Arrogant Reaper Ending already featured within the game. Boss fights will play out similarly, and the overall pace of the scenes will feel familiar.

An an aside, obtaining the Insecure Reaper Fragment will unlock the True Reaper. This is why there is no specific ending for the Insecure Reaper, as you will already have satisfied the conditions for the True Reaper Ending.

[h3]Special Soul Fragment Endings[/h3][list][*][b]Soulless Reaper Ending.[/b] Dreary visions have been haunting the Soul Reaper for quite some time, and it's becoming increasingly difficult to discern dreams from reality. What exactly is happening…?
[*][b]True Reaper Ending.[/b] With his faculties reunited, the Soul Reaper demands answers from The Midnight Council. Why are they so committed to fulfilling their doomsday prophecy?
[/list]
These diverge fairly significantly from the Single Soul Endings. We don't want to spoil the surprise, but look forward to seeing some intriguing twists!

[h3]New Scenes[/h3]To help flesh out both the lore and characters of Soul Reaper, we've written scripts for two new scenes that will be added to The Void!

The scene triggers will exist along the path to the final boss (located to the right of Vypo). One is intended to be viewed after defeating the Soiloth, and the other, after defeating Jeff. As an incentive to encounter these scenes when intended, a treasure chest will be placed alongside each scene trigger to encourage exploration with the newly gained boss abilities.[list][*][b]Percie's Predicament.[/b] Percie and Vipo argue over the portal to the Predeath, and Vypo steps in as a reluctant mediator to tame the heated discussion.
[*][b]Vault Time.[/b] Vypo explains the theory of "Vault Time," a potential reason as to why those who dwell in the The Vault seem to part with their memories so easily.
[/list]
[h3]Small Talk[/h3]In the introduction section, players will be given the opportunity to speak with the twins before heading off to fight the Herald. It's a small addition, but these short conversations will help give an idea of how Vipo and Vypo typically interact with their boss early on.

[h3]So, When Will All This Cool Stuff Be Implemented?[/h3]As of now, we don't have a specific date as to when the new endings or scenes will be added [i]just[/i] yet. Ideally, we'd like to start including the new narrative pieces in future patches (as in, adding an ending here and there alongside the bug fix updates), but we don't want to hard commit to a date until we know for sure that the new content will be ready.

On a related note, it's hard to ignore the change in climate since our previous update. While we're blessed to be able to work remotely, it's difficult to say with certainty that the recent pandemic won't impact the speed of Soul Reaper's development. Rest assured, we're still actively working on the project! However, we wanted to bring this up in the event we need to extend the Early Access period beyond the initial 3 month plan. We'll see where we are in the coming weeks, and make an announcement if we feel the game would benefit from more time in development.

These are unprecedented times, and we hope you all are able to maintain both health and high spirits. With enough perseverance, we'll make it through unscathed! Please, stay safe out there!

[h3]Mac Build[/h3]In a previous update, we mentioned that Soul Reaper's Mac release would be postponed due to a notarization process required by Apple. While we're still fully committed to having a Mac build, we've decided it would be best to focus exclusively on the Windows version first. This would allow us to better improve our workflow, as maintaining both a Mac and Windows build simultaneously would be rather resource heavy on the team.

Once most bugs have been fixed and the majority of content has been added to the game, we'll once again start making preparations for the Mac release!

(In the meantime, players can still access the Open Beta for Mac [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]here[/url] if they'd like to get a head start on their adventure!)

[h3]The Animation Sensation (Cunning Creatures and April Fools Addition)[/h3]We've uploaded quite a number of videos since we've last spoken! So many, in fact, that it'd be easier on the eyes to simply link you to our YouTube playlists!

For our recent monster animation previews (Zeppelineer and beyond), click [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c6wXbp-aqYY&list=PL4tJLUwQqfiRseyLmA2YUQUsl2WcNdBAW&index=21]here[/url]!

For our recent gameplay videos (Percie's New Loot Smithing and beyond), click [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dv0UGW4z3TY&list=PL4tJLUwQqfiR2V1_htdpmBbk01nl8bnUi&index=29]here[/url]!

One video we'd like to give special attention to is our Scramrock Animation Preview. It floats gracefully in the wind before it, well… dies. A strange inclusion to be sure, but a fitting creature to showcase on April Fools!

[previewyoutube=OslXWdQzu7o;full][/previewyoutube][i]It might not have many animations, but that doesn't mean it's not important! Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1HxUQOYudDU]Scramrock series[/url] to learn how you can buff up your squad with Scramrocks![/i]

[h3]Follow Us![/h3]That about wraps things up for this update! The feedback we've been receiving continues to shape our work for the better, so please don't hesitate to share your opinion with us! Our [url=https://discord.gg/erupmSD]Discord[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/]Steam Community[/url] are the easiest ways of making your voice heard, but feel free to reach out to us via any of our social media links below! notes.notes:
Hello fellow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163660/Soul_Reaper/]reapers of souls[/url]!

Today we’re hitting you up with a surprise patch: 0.1.2p1!

For the sake of brevity (we have souls to reap too, you know!), here’s the change log (in order they were fixed no less!):

[i](Potential spoiler alerts below)[/i][list][*]Fixed the Astronaut artifact set giving a bonus of 1% instead of 100%
[*]Reduced the [i]Fire Damage[/i] of the Drakey Toothey
[*]Created a level 200 version of the Drakey Toothey
[*][b]Fixed bug where the following passive attributes from Souls in loot were 10x higher then they were designed to be:[/b] [i]Physical, Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Poison, Light,[/i] and [i]Dark Damage.[/i] This affects the following souls: [i]Inferndhole, Cannondorf, Stabbytabby, Hydroviathan, Snipine, Cyclord, Helminoth, Phantomb, Portobellows, Toxicritter, Boozooka, Cthulhu,[/i] and [i]Shadooze.[/i] (more on that below)
[*]Fixed some issues starting in New Game Plus
[*]Fixed area where you can go off the map in Elysium 2
[*]Fixed Soul Reaper illuminating rocks on some Elysium maps
[*]Temporarily removed the Cancel button from the World Map screen (it wasn’t working as designed)
[*]Fixed a typo in Percie’s dialogue
[*]Fixed Reset Station giving you infinite stat points
[*]Fixed monster issues in Polarus 25, Elysium 15, and Elysium 25
[*]Fixed being able to destroy igloos before collecting them
[*]Fixed teleporter in Elysium 25 not leading to the right map
[*]Fixed size of panel for devouring souls
[*]Fixed size of panels for smithing
[*]Fixed treasure chest not opening in Elysium 7
[*]Fixed bat triggers in Volcanheim 14
[*]Fixed waypoint to Jeff not displaying at the right spot on the World Map
[*]Fixed soul level display on the victory panel
[/list]
[h2]What’s up with the nerf?[/h2]
Did you read the bolded change above? Well, that broke the game in ways never intended (are there intended ways to break the game in the design?).

What’s important to note about this nerf is that it will give you a lot more options about how to be strong, as opposed to relying only on these attributes and being completely indestructible.

Here’s a screenshot from one of our top players:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/6347f02f9b924da95cd727ca827e4f7b62e5a529.png[/img]

He was doing 1.3M damage. That’s enough to kill the final boss 10x in a single hit. He even reported doing over 2M damage in 0.1.2. He has a stellar team and should be rewarded for his efforts (he played over 110 hours). Even with the current patch, he’ll still destroy the final boss in a single hit while doing 10x less damage.

This change makes other options just as efficient as the whole method, allowing players to play with the style they want to play, and making all other souls just as valuable.

We think that this change makes the game more fun for more people overall.

Whew, we have been [i][b]busy![/b][/i]

Soul Reaper entered [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163660/Soul_Reaper/]Early Access[/url] back on February 4th, and we've been working around the clock to make sure that those sharing their first impressions are heard. We've learned a lot about what needs adjusting, and the reception has helped us shape our next big update: Version 0.1.1!

[h1]Accessing The New Build[/h1]
There's a lot of changes featured in the new version; so much so that we'll be releasing it as a Beta branch on Steam. While there are plenty of improvements in 0.1.1, it's possible that by introducing so many changes at once, other oddities may spring up alongside the fixes. We're still testing the new build to make sure that everything is working smoothly, but in the event users take issue with the updated version, they can hop right back to 0.1.0p1! Players will have a choice to utilize the new build by accessing the "Betas" tab under Soul Reaper's Steam properties. (Right click the game in your library, then select "Properties..." to find the tab.)

Version 0.1.1 will remain in Beta for up to two weeks before entering the main branch (and replacing 0.1.0p1 in the process). Give the new build a try, and let us know what you think!

[h1]0.1.1 Changelog[/h1]
This is a big one, and it's all thanks to you! Community feedback has been vital to Soul Reaper's success, and we hope you enjoy these changes!
[list][*]Addressed an issue that would cause Bunippys to remove their targets from the Turn Order Table.
[*]Revised the intro sequence to have less dialogue. Soul Reaper is now a squad unit in the tutorial Nuttercutter fight, and also has access to different souls.
[*]Fixed collision on Soiloth's vines in Volcanheim 19: Volcadillo Crater.
[*]Added the ability to teleport back to The Void from anywhere! Hit the "T" button on the keyboard, or "Y" button (XBox controls) on a controller to warp.
[*]Removed bush in Volcanheim 9: Cardinorclan that prevented users from passing.
[*]Fixed an issue where units would target the wrong enemy on the first turn of battle.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Minimap would incorrectly display after using a teleporter.
[*]Fixed several UI oddities where buttons would grow or shrink to disproportional sizes. Also fixed an issue where Soul Reaper's HP Bar would obscure the bottom portion of the screen.
[*]Made several changes to grammar and spelling in dialogue/menus.
[*]Soul Reaper now runs a little faster! (Speed increased by 20%.)
[*]Scramrocks can now properly flee from battle.
[*]Scramrocks were too difficult to kill in the previous version, and now scale more appropriately with each area.
[*]Upon defeating the Arrogant Reaper while Soulless, the change will now be immediately reflected in the menu (as opposed to still being Soulless with no damage bonus).
[*]Collision of several background objects have been adjusted to not overlap creatures/Soul Reaper on the foreground.
[*]Area titles no longer display in the intro.
[*]Certain areas now display the game's controls on the bottom of the screen.
[*]The collision hitbox on the Lumareous is now larger, making it easier to enter a fight.
[*]Fixed an issue where users could not mouse over the rightmost souls/treasure on the Victory screen in Polarus.
[*]Combat speed should now increase/decrease by intervals of 0.5x.
[*]Fixed an issue where tooltips during squad management would permanently remain while highlighting different buttons. They now disappear after 4 seconds.
[*]Returning to the Title Screen no longer causes music tracks to overlap.
[*]The pushable boulder in Volcanheim 6: Double-sided has been replaced with a Balboa boulder.
[*]Artifacts now work in conjunction with Soul Reaper!
[*]Players can now skip pages with the keyboard when speaking to the Tutorial Dude.
[*]Boss music no longer plays over regular fights.

We took a lot of notes over these past few weeks, and there's still plenty of great suggestions we're going to try to implement. In the meantime, we hope you enjoy the additions made to Soul Reaper's newest version!

Last week, we ran a mini-series highlighting Soul Reaper's most elusive creature: the Scramrock. They're 4-Leaf Clovers hidden throughout the game that offer massive XP boosts if utilized correctly. If you're looking to pump up your boss monsters, Scramrocks are definitely the way to go!

notes.title: Soul Reaper Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Do my eyes deceive me? Is today finally the day?! …[b]IT IS![/b] It's February 4th, and Soul Reaper has launched onto [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163660/Soul_Reaper/]Steam Early Access![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/4bc9b4e2be7f045bda938655973138c02599d55d.jpg[/img][i]No one shatters the Soul Reaper's psyche and gets away with it! Stand strong, and take back what's yours![/i]

It's been an absolutely wild ride, and we're unbelievably ecstatic to announce that the game we've been working so hard on is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163660/Soul_Reaper/]finally available to purchase[/url]! Truly, dreams can come true!

I'm so happy, I could cry… But I won't! I promised the family we'd be going fishing in the Elysium lakes, and there's no time for cutting onions! It's a big day for us [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BAxIhSAvD88]Stabbytabbys[/url] too, and we take pride in our impeccable skewering techniques. …What? What do you mean you've seen [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7DUwa98yBk]Reefraffs[/url] swimming in lava? …But I can't fish in Volcanheim! I'm a cat!

Bah, enough of my rambling! There's plenty of things to discuss; it is launch day after all!

[h1]Available Platforms[/h1]
Soul Reaper is ready to go for Windows 10 systems, and you should be able to grab it from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163660/Soul_Reaper/]Steam page[/url] right away!

In our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1163660/announcements/detail/1697229319591726322]previous Dev Blog[/url], we mentioned that the Mac build of Soul Reaper would need to undergo an additional notarization requirement outlined by Apple. We weren't anticipating this additional hurdle, and as a result, needed to postpone the Mac release temporarily. Much of Soul Reaper was coded using Mac laptops, and it pains us to know it won't be launching alongside the PC release. We deeply apologize for the inconvenience, and as a consolation, we'll be extending the Mac version of Soul Reaper's [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]Open Beta[/url].

We're working hard to get the Early Access version ready for Steam, and we expect it to be available within the coming weeks!

[h1]Arm Yourself With Knowledge![/h1]
Before you embark on your soul reaping adventure, there's a few key things you should know!

[h2]Our Ghostly Friend, The Tutorial Dude[/h2]
The world of Soul Reaper is populated by a wise, old specter! Speak to him if you'd like to learn more about the game and its intricacies!

[previewyoutube=-ZmWlJzuSSE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Guides by The Man Himself[/h2]
The project lead, Danny Forest, has written several detailed guides explaining how users can harness the game's more in-depth mechanics! For tips on leveling, loot, and more, check out our Guides section [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides]here[/url]! (They were based on older builds, but most of the information still applies quite well!)

[h2]A Split Personality[/h2]
The Soul Reaper has suffered a psyche-shattering injury that's caused his emotions to break apart from his body! Recollect yourself by defeating the impostor Soul Reapers, and select which Reaper Fragment you'd like to equip! You can get some pretty humorous conversations going depending on which Fragment you use, and you'll even apply some neat stat bonuses too!

[previewyoutube=fuwBen8Hg60;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Super Effective Attacks![/h2]
Water beats Fire, Fire beats Earth, Earth beats Wind, and Wind beats Water!

Light and Dark deal massive damage to each other, while Poison and Physical (Neutral) have no inherent weakness or advantage!

Small, element icons appear near each unit's health bar to indicate which type of monster you're looking at. If you ever need a refresher on which element to use, you can always reference the elemental color wheel that appears when combat is paused!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/df67872e4599f8bdd435ebedd5aa6d482b932aea.jpg[/img][i]Check the bottom left icon for the elemental diagram! (Effectiveness in clockwise motion.)[/i]

[h2]The Utility of Souls[/h2]
[b]Souls can be:[/b][list]
[*]added to your combat squads to fight in battle!
[*]fused with other souls to boost their levels!
[*]devoured by the Soul Reaper to increase his XP!
[*]slotted into equipment for additional bonuses!
[*]smithed into loot pieces by Percie![/list]

There's no right or wrong way to use the souls you've collected! Allocate them as you see fit, and find a method that works best for you!

[h2]The Masked Twins[/h2]
Vipo (the smiley one) and Vypo (the frowny one) are committed to helping their boss however they can! While they don't accompany the Soul Reaper on his travels, they each have an important role to fill back in The Void!

Vypo keeps tabs on The Midnight Council's lieutenants, and will give you directions to the next boss fight! Speak with him if you're ever stumped as to where you need to go next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/a5c5dd968656f5502e396e3c9880038560d779a7.png[/img][i]For someone so frowny, he sure is happy to help![/i]

Vipo, on the other hand, will grant rewards based on how many Feats you've accomplished! Feats are tasks you can complete (Ex: Reap 100 souls), and they unlock some pretty nice prizes! Speak with her frequently to see what souls or items you can receive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/11c2c1396330505775905aea78e1e02f3246e769.png[/img][i]Time to reap the rewards of… Well, reaping![/i]

[h2]Join in on the Conversation![/h2]
Player feedback is critical to both the development and success of Soul Reaper! If you've encountered a bug, feel free to use our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdODH_fTmOUUUrFrJvTptLAOMAZFb5gThQ76vYP7ueWgp-uQQ/viewform]Bug Reporting Form[/url] to shoot a message directly our way! (List of currently known issues will appear [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/0/1696095261009337499/]here[/url]!)

In addition, you're more than welcome to share your opinion on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/erupmSD]Discord[/url]! Let us know what you think about the game's balance, drop rates, or anything, really! We can't make Soul Reaper the very best it can be without the input from the community, and we're super thankful to all those who have supported us throughout the Open Beta! Keep the recommendations coming, and our build updates will continue to improve!

[h2]Frequency of Updates[/h2]
We're currently aiming to provide updates to the Early Access build every 30 or so days! Changelogs will be featured in coinciding Dev Blogs, and will be presented much like how they were for the updated builds of the Open Beta.

[h2]Twitch Box Art![/h2]
Some of you may recall the mention of Soul Reaper's entry on Giant Bomb. This was done around the time of our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1163660/announcements/detail/1604897915912527024]Halloween Dev Blog[/url], and let Soul Reaper appear in Twitch's directory! Recently, Danny Forest had submitted a box art icon for the game to appear beside its name!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/50e6f00dafe2023156e07c5c0a1e5cf5c636a9ff.png[/img]
[i]Three bosses on your team? The Soul Reaper isn't pulling any punches![/i]

With this, everything should be good to go on Twitch! Feel free to stream Soul Reaper to your heart's content, and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Soul%20Reaper]follow the category[/url] to get notified of new streams!

[h2]A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words[/h2]
Defeat a tough boss battle? Find some wicked loot? Why not take a picture using Steam's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=181142704]screenshot feature[/url], and be the first to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/screenshots/]populate the community tab for Soul Reaper[/url]! We'd love to see any legendary drops you've picked up from battle, or some awesome squad arrangements with your monsters!

notes.title: Reaper Fragments + Mac Build Update
notes.notes:
Salutations, Reapers! I hope your ventures are treating you well, and that you've been nabbing some excellent souls along the way! While I, a humble cat with a hook, don't find myself challenging monsters all too often, I do squeal with delight whenever I knock out some Reefraffs. My love for fish is truly undying! (The same cannot be said about my cooking… I just bring them home and my family does the rest.)

Anyway! Enough about that; Soul Reaper is under two weeks away from launching onto Steam Early Access! The folks over here at Power Level Studios have been pouring their souls (I've made this joke before, haven't I?) into this game, and it's a fantastic feeling to know we're almost there!

To help prepare Reapers of both new and old, I've compiled a series of short videos showcasing Reaper Fragments! I ran a mini-series this week, and here's the culmination of my work! (Video editing with a hook and claw is tricky, but definitely doable!)

[h1]Emotion Commotion[/h1]
Reaper Fragments are bits of the Soul Reaper's psyche that were forcefully separated from his body! (That Herald guy is gonna pay!) They've each taken sentient form in a Soul Reaper lookalike, and behave according to their assigned emotion.

[previewyoutube=fuwBen8Hg60;full][/previewyoutube][i]Seven?! I knew the Soul Reaper was popular, but he's got quite the fan club now that his soul has been severed! That's a lot of doppelgangers…[/i]

Each Fragment will apply a specific Row Bonus if the Soul Reaper is used in combat. You'll also be able to gain more XP from devouring souls depending on which Fragment you currently have selected! (For more details, see our Guide [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides/a-reapers-guide-to-becoming-a-truly-powerful-soul-reaper]here[/url]!)

[previewyoutube=3V6GGr9qKaY;full][/previewyoutube][i]Arrogant, the first Reaper Fragment you unlock, boosts Fire Damage across Soul Reaper's row![/i]

While outside of combat, Reaper Fragments dictate how the Soul Reaper will behave in conversation! Try swapping them before boss fights to prompt different discussions!

[previewyoutube=5izwDJzdntY;full][/previewyoutube][i]The Romantic Fragment makes the Soul Reaper sweet-talk almost everyone he comes across. It's quite amusing![/i]

Lastly, when all Reaper Fragments are collected, the Soul Reaper's eyes will return to a bright white. You still have control over which Fragment to select, so be mindful of your current damage bonus and emotion!

[previewyoutube=bf-cAsxyobg;full][/previewyoutube][i]It feels good to be whole! (He was looking like he needed eye-drops for a moment there…)[/i]

Upon death, Reaper Fragments are lost in a [b]LIFO[/b] format. In other words, the last one you collected is the first one to go! Fret not, however, as you can always rematch a doppelganger later! Return to the place you discovered the Fragment, and he'll be waiting!

Currently, Soul Reaper has one ending fully complete. While Reaper Fragments won't influence the resolution of the game just yet, we do have plans to include alternate endings based on which Fragment is used for the final fight. In the meantime, try speaking with bosses or NPCs with different Fragments! There's plenty of unique dialogue already in the game; we hope you enjoy some of the peculiar discussions you'll find Soul Reaper partake in!

[h1]A Notice For Mac Users[/h1]
During the Open Beta, we've been vigilant at releasing each updated build simultaneously for both Windows and Mac. We're big fans of both platforms, and over the years, much of Soul Reaper was actually programmed + tested on Macbook devices!

Unfortunately, due to unforeseen circumstances, the Mac release of the Early Access build will need to be pushed back by a few weeks. As per Apple's new requirements, games now have to go through a notarization process that we previously didn't need to account for. (Unreap Commander's Mac version required no such thing.) We're looking to resolve the issue as quickly as we can, but for now, we sadly won't be able to commit to a Mac release for February 4th.

As a consolation, we'll be extending the Mac version of Soul Reaper's [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]Open Beta[/url] until the Early Access build is approved. While not as polished, Mac users will still be able to get a feel for how Soul Reaper's main gameplay loop functions via the Open Beta. We understand this isn't a perfect compromise by any means, and we apologize to those who were looking forward to playing the Mac version at launch. We've updated our Steam page to reflect this change, and we'll let the community know the moment we have a date for the Mac release.

[h1]For Further Updates[/h1]
Not exactly the happiest note to leave off of, but rest assured, we'll let you know more the moment we can! You'll see us posting content fairly regularly to our social media, so we'll drop some links below in case you wanted to stay tuned! notes.title: Soul Reaper - Ver. 0.0.3 Out Now!
notes.notes:
As snow continues to coat the roads in a cold blanket of white, Power Level Studios remains unperturbed by the elements and has been pushing forward with a fiery passion! Rather than going out and making snow angels, we've been enjoying our time huddling up to our fireplaces (i.e. computer exhaust fans) and adding new additions to the game! As exciting as it is to wander out into the below-zero wonderland, we have instead opted to bring the Winter landscape to [i]you[/i]. Yup, that's right! Version 0.0.3 is [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]ready to download[/url], and [b]Polarus is now available to explore![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/4e594854fabf06d9a01d76a15514a5caf39132f5.jpg[/img]
[i]Polarus is the third and final layer of The Vault. Quite the "polar" opposite of Volcanheim, no?[/i]

This snowy plane takes no prisoners. Get ready to fight some of the most dastardly creatures around, and prepare yourself for Soul Reaper's toughest challenge yet: [i][b]mathematics[/b][/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/a067c34ca7c11ea9cef7e95e78bfc24ea2e36c87.png[/img]
[i]The Alchemutant is one of the final remaining boss souls available to capture. If you can't prove your mettle through math, then perhaps you can "persuade" him like you did the others?[/i]

The Alchemutant presents an interesting ability for those able to recruit the mad scientist. Upon finding an igloo on the icy field, players will be able to shrink down and retrieve treasure from the inside!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/9ec8b73b93c28512a78f4c56ac3c5ee97604f490.png[/img]
[i]I wonder what those little guys are hiding? Only one way to find out![/i]

That being said, it's important to remember that Polarus is one of the final locations in the game. It's going to be pretty tough to navigate through its monsters and terrain if you aren't prepared! If you're feeling a little lost, we recently added a [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides]Guides[/url] section to our website that details how to prime up your squads for combat! There's a lot of mechanics you can take advantage of in Soul Reaper, so give it a gander if you'd like tips on maximizing your effectiveness in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/2acc94f47793b669683c730680b2e29866b01011.png[/img]
[i]Of course, you can always talk to Vypo for guidance! He'll point you in the direction of new bosses to fight![/i]

[h1]A Place For Everything, and Everything in Its Place[/h1]
While Polarus is a fantastic addition to 0.0.3, there's plenty more to see than just a new area! One of the first things that will jump out to players is the new UI in combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/e387e66545854529d9e3895cb5550321ea5195b4.png[/img]
[i]No longer will you need your Reapedia by your side! There's plenty of visual identifiers to reference on the battlefield, making it easy to know how to proceed![/i]

For starters, the player's squad is now on the left side of the field! This has been a heavily requested adjustment, and we're pleased to announce its inclusion within the newest version!

Secondly, the Turn Order table is now prominently displayed across the left side of the screen. It even includes turns 6 and 7, which weren't previously visible in 0.0.2! This makes it far easier to plan ahead in battle, and should give the player a better idea as to when they should heal or attack.

Element types are also now visible! Creatures that aren't Poison or Neutral will now have their respective element displayed beside their health bars. This change makes it far more intuitive to plan out super effective attacks!

Finally, Row Bonuses are now displayed under each squad's name. Highlighting an enemy will pop up the bonuses currently being applied to their row, allowing players to quickly check what exactly they're dealing with.

[previewyoutube=Um4XPdp4HgY;full][/previewyoutube] [i]As a quick reminder, it's great to arrange your units into rows! You'll share stat bonuses that way! For a thorough guide on harnessing these bonuses, check out our article [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides/how-to-build-a-kick-ass-squad-in-under-10-hours-in-soul-reaper]here[/url]![/i]

[h1]List of Updates and Improvements[/h1]
It's that time again! Below is another changelog compiled by Danny Forest that overviews both the major and minor changes found in Version 0.0.3. This man has been working around the clock to fix bugs while adding in new content, and we can't thank him enough for his incredible work! Without further adieu, the list of adjustments is as follows:

[b]Major features[/b][list]
[*] All worlds unlocked
[*] All bosses unlocked
[*] All Soul Reaper Fragments unlocked
[*] Tons of menu UX and UI improvements
[*] All boss and Soul reaper fragment dialogues (that's a ton guys!)
[*] 300 feats available, all rebalanced to give extraordinary rewards
[*] Combat UI redesign
[*] Major rebalancing in many areas
[*] Half of the treasure chests are designed and implemented, giving awesome rewards every time!
[*] Game progression rebalancing
[/list]

[b]Minor features and changes[/b][list]
[*] Better controller support (but still not fully usable)
[*] Fixed Octoblader's web sprite missing
[*] Fixed ability icons not always showing up
[*] Now starting the game with 3 Soul Gear
[*] Fixed tons of monster behaviors not working as expected in the Vault
[*] Redesigned flow for Soul Smithing
[*] Redesigned Game Over screen
[*] Fixed collision boxes on many monsters in the Vault
[*] Fixed tons of invisible walls in many levels
[*] Fixed tons of other bugs in many levels
[*] Added proper music for Polarus
[*] Implemented some Vypo dialogues to give you directions on where to go next
[*] Support for loot that can amplify specific souls' power
[*] Fixed Soul Reaper level up display when leveling up by more than one level
[*] Added an animation for when Soul Reaper levels up
[*] Added a loading screen when selecting a save file
[*] Fixed a bug that respawned bosses when opening and closing the menu on top of a boss
[/list]

Quite the slew of changes, isn't it? Remember, much of these improvements wouldn't have been made possible without the phenomenal support from the community! You guys have been amazing with providing feedback (both on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url] and in private), and we can't thank you enough for continuing to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/0/1696095261009337499/]submit bug reports[/url] via our submission document! This stuff helps [i]a ton[/i], and Soul Reaper's development is moving much more smoothly thanks to it!

[h1]The Animation Sensation (Trees, Pandas, and Puffers, Oh My!)[/h1]
It's been a while since we've done another round of monster animations! Check out the groovy movements of the Commandapanda, Malignatree, and Needlypuff below!

[previewyoutube=uydNzWggbKw;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]A chill panda with an "enlightened" state of mind. This fella doesn't move, but it can emit some pretty powerful light waves from its stomach![/i]

[previewyoutube=lteCBVoGtHY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The Malignatree isn't the kind of "giving tree" I'd like to hang around… Beware those poison apples![/i]

[previewyoutube=qgcpkTfaA-M;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]This fish shoots out arrows in any which way it can. Neat talent, but probably not what it expected when signing up for archery class. Those darn Snipines![/i]

notes.title: Guiding The Soul to Victory
notes.notes:
Whoa, things are getting chilly out there, aren't they? As the fallen leaves become painted white, there's no better time to cozy up to some hot coco while navigating the blistering terrain in Volcanheim. Lava a little too extreme? Why not swing by the lush and lively planes of Elysium! These two areas are free to explore in the [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]Open Beta[/url], so give 'em a shot if you'd like to crush those icy Winter Blues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/d64ce167ef6a58f6bdbc4a38a3ddeb082e34023d.png[/img][i]Nothing screams "Summer" quite like running from a Fournicorn's spikes or a Volcadillo's projectiles![/i]

The snow hasn't kept Power Level Studios from slowing down at all! (If anything, it's more of an incentive to stay at our screens!) There's plenty of news to cover since the last Dev Blog, and we've got some neat things we'd like to share regarding future updates!

[h1]Arm Yourself With Knowledge[/h1]
Our website has a new section! Click the [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides]Guides[/url] tab to launch yourself into a plethora of helpful tips and handy tricks, all written by Danny Forest himself!

For starters, we've ported over the squad building guide from a few weeks back. You'll find it at its new location [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides/how-to-build-a-kick-ass-squad-in-under-10-hours-in-soul-reaper]here[/url]! While it was built with an older version in mind (one without the Soul Reaper as a playable unit), this guide still covers the essentials required to harness the full power of Row Bonuses. If you're looking to build synergy between your creatures, this is an excellent place to begin!

Looking to learn more about the intricacies surrounding Loot? Want to make some powerful combinations, but don't know where to start? Try out our "Loots Galore!" guide [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides/loot-galore]here[/url]! It explains the basics such as drop rates and attributes, then delves into the world of "Soul Gear". Attaching certain souls onto loot pieces can unlock some crazy bonuses, so take advantage of it where you can!

Want to make the Soul Reaper an unstoppable reaping machine? Look no further, as our new Leveling guide can be found [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/guides/a-reapers-guide-to-becoming-a-truly-powerful-soul-reaper]here[/url]! This article explains how players can use the Reaper Fragments collected from the "impostor" boss fights to bolster the Soul Reaper's effectiveness in combat. The Agility stat cannot be emphasized enough here, as being able to have more turns can lead the Soul Reaper to not only become a fearsome fighter, but also a surprisingly effective healer.

[h1]Montreal International Gaming Summit![/h1]
Power Level Studios held another public playtesting event mid November - this time, at the [url=https://www.facebook.com/MontrealGameSummit/]MEGA+MIGS 2019[/url] event in Montreal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/69f3561eb0eaec5643fac79b455abd6c5586dbed.jpg[/img][i]They gave us a pretty awesome booth! It was really cool to have our promotional art displayed like that, and we even had some guests that recognized us from previous events![/i]

The experience was nothing less than stellar! These playtests have really helped open our eyes as to where we should proceed with certain design choices, and they continue to be an imperative resource for Soul Reaper's development! At MIGS in particular, we noticed that most players had no idea of where the turn-order icons were located! (In the build we were presenting, they were vertically stacked in the top left corner.) We plan to tweak these icons for future builds, and apply a layout that better emphasizes their importance during battle.

[h1]Bite-Sized Surprises[/h1]
While our next big update is right around the corner, we've been sneaking in smaller patches as we continue to improve on Soul Reaper's design! We now have an "X.X.XpX" nomenclature for versions of the Open Beta, where "pX" indicates the most recent patch for that particular build.

For example, we've made an improvement to the targeting animation that appears when you select an opponent in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/bcdde7243fea0a9300f55fbaba51f322f567a959.png[/img][i]Target acquired![/i]

We've also made a few general UI improvements, bug fixes, and other QoL changes that offer an overall better experience. As of the time of writing, we're currently on version 0.0.2p3! If you're still rocking an unpatched 0.0.2, you might be pleasantly surprised as to the changes you'll find in the most recent update!

Oh, and remember when I said that the next big update is right around the corner? We're aiming to have version 0.0.3 available sometime next week! This will include the snowy region of Polarus for all to explore, and will feature some intense boss fights to boot! You'll definitely want to keep those guides handy, just in case!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/09aafdc05a3abebcf8df350c19effcdfd4c01669.png[/img][i]For those who love the Winter season, Polarus has got you covered![/i]

[h1]Volcanheim and the Mandela Effect[/h1]
"Volcanheim", or "Volcanhiem"? That is the question. We were intrigued to learn that everyone's favorite volcanic landscape had somehow found its way to possess two unique spellings, both of which are represented in official media! Freaky, huh? While we can't quite rule out the (infinitesimally small) chance that Soul Reaper's development has somehow hopped realities, we can say with confidence that we'll be doubling down on the "Volcanheim" spelling from here on in. We blame the local Stabbytabby for any confusion, and he will not be receiving his special Reefraff dessert tonight as punishment.

[h1]Follow Us![/h1]
That about wraps things up for this update! Remember to check out Soul Reaper's Open Beta at [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]powerlevelstudios.com/beta[/url], and let us know what you think! notes.title: Soul Reaper - Build 0.0.2 Out Now!
notes.notes:
Halloween marked the first public release of Soul Reaper's Open Beta, and the last few weeks have been simply incredible for us! We've had many one-on-one conversations with users describing their first impressions, and we've received a multitude of amazing recommendations since the build went live! Our team has been keeping a careful eye on the bugs submitted via our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/0/1696095261009337499/]Bug Reporting Form[/url], and this next build will see a series of improvements based on all the amazing feedback!

Grab the new build here at [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/beta]powerlevelstudios.com/beta[/url]!

Before we even get into the changes, let's take a look at the new content added in this update! For starters, [b]Elysium is now available to explore![/b]

[h1]Cloud Nine, Baby![/h1]
Players are no longer restricted to just Volcanhiem! You'll be able to explore the grassy landscape of Elysium, a series of floating islands in The Vault! While the terrain is more vibrant and carefree, don't be fooled! There are some seriously strong monsters (and bosses!) in this area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/acf40efe3d518c08dc64d142a40005a00c508fd5.png[/img][i]Elysium is the second layer of The Vault, and comes equipped with some pretty powerful foes![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/15470051c32cfddf7f2dae5a84fff78760b56691.jpg[/img][i]Green grass, blue skies, and floating islands await! Make sure to keep your head out of the clouds though, you never know what might be lurking in the shroud![/i]

While the new area is a sizable addition to Soul Reaper's current landscape, there's another major change involving our favorite cloaked hero. Get ready for a twist, because…

[h1]The Soul Reaper… Joins The Fight!?![/h1]
That's right, the Soul Reaper himself can now be added to the combat grid! While he's still more than comfortable issuing orders to his subservient souls, there are times where standing out by the sidelines simply won't due. He takes his job as Warden of The Vault pretty seriously, and he'll hop onto the battlefield if necessary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/7d51cc6aeb5ceec41f350f547df3fc165cc2531d.png[/img][i]You know what they say. If you want something done right…[/i]

While a really cool change to the system, such a decision didn't just spawn out of thin air! There's a number of factors that lead to his implementation, so allow me to explain!

Firstly, we felt that giving players the option to select Soul Reaper as a unit would add far more value in powering him up! Players will now get to experience the full set of his attributes in combat, and can create some crafty row bonus combinations with him as well! This way, you'll be getting a lot more mileage out of leveling up the Soul Reaper than you would have otherwise!

Secondly, it also gives the player more use out of the Soul Reaper's fragments! By besting your impostors in combat, you'll be able to utilize unique row bonuses based on the fragments you collect! Nifty, huh?

Lastly, it presents an interesting fallback should a player decide to devour or trash all of their souls. Take the following situation, for example. A player starts a new file, and immediately sacrifices their souls to boost the Soul Reaper. Without any souls on the battlefield, he actually won't get the opportunity to flex his newfound muscle! Any combat would result in an immediate loss, preventing the player from obtaining any new souls! (While we could offer free souls in this scenario, such a gesture would be rather easy to exploit.)

All in all, allowing users to throw the Soul Reaper onto the battlefield improves his utility, and provides even more unique ways to progress throughout the game. With this, we hope that you'll give him a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/0638cfdd80f9968d63e02ecac6cfdb483b42a966.jpg[/img][i]Send me in, coach![/i]

The feature is brand new, so using Soul Reaper as a monster unit isn't quite as polished as we'd like it to be just yet. Still, it's a great way to spice up your squads while giving the player an option to fight if all souls have been consumed. Take him for a spin in 0.0.2, and let us know how it goes! (Oh, and he behaves like a normal element type! So nothing is super effective by, or against him!)

[h1]What's Changed Since the Last Version?[/h1]
There's been a number of improvements made to version 0.0.2! We'll outline all of the adjustments below! (List compiled by the man himself, Danny Forest!)

[b]Major Features and Additions[/b][list]
[*]Feats system: Perform various things to complete feats and earn rewards:
   [b]a)[/b] New menu section
   [b]b)[/b] Talk to Vipo to claim your rewards
   [b]c)[/b] 321 feats right in that version!
[*]Each fragment unlock improves the exp you get from devouring a specific type of soul. For example, the Romantic fragment increases exp gained from devouring water-based monsters by 10x!
[*]You can now "equip" fragments of previous Soul Reapers you've defeated.
[*]Equipping a fragment affects many things in the game:
 [b]a)[/b] The eye color
[b]b)[/b] The dialogues with all NPCs in the game
[b]c)[/b] You get a different row bonus depending on fragment you equip (more on that just below)
[*]Soul Reaper can now be added to your Squads!
 [b]a)[/b] In the squad, Soul Reaper makes use of all available stats (for example, health and resistances on Soul Reaper had no use before)
 [b]b)[/b] Soul Reaper has a row bonus that depends on the fragment equipped. For example, the Arrogant fragment boosts Fire Damage Bonus.
[*]Elysium is now unlocked, leading to 3 new bosses with new abilities to use in the Vault. Two of the bosses are in Elysium and the other one can be found in Volcanhiem later.
[/list]
[b]Minor Features and Changes[/b][list]
[*]Soul Reaper is now easier to level up and levelling up gives him more stat points
[*]Soul steal chance is now defaulted to 70% (up from 40%)
[*]Soul Find attribute can now spawn on any loot (only affects the unit with the loot equipped)
[*]You now start the game with Soul Reaper in your squad, instead of a Nuttercutter
[*]Bug fix: You can no longer be stuck with having no units to add to your squad (the Soul Reaper never goes away)
[*]Nicer display for choosing the save file
[*]Tons of bugs fixes and progression improvements in Volcanhiem
[*]Fixed all monster behaviours in the Vault
[*]Added Badnanas and Damnabull to Vault maps
[*]Fixed minor issues affecting combat (like Soul Reaper not having a default target)
[*]Ignopede now spawns geysers (this may change in the future)
[*]Now saving the equipped squad index so when you restart you start the game with the same squad
[*]Fixed Opponent Soul Reapers looking the wrong way and having no eye color
[*]Tons of new dialogues all over (Vypo now gives useful tips on progress)
[*]Some Combat UI adjustments
[*]Tons of Menu UI improvements
[*]Fixed bug preventing selection of arsenal loot or squad units at the bottom of the screen (in the menu)
[*]Fixed keeping overpowered loot from the intro
[*]Fixed menu issues with Percie (merchant)
[*]Tons of dialogue fixes
[*]Hold "left shift" in combat to see the actual health values of all the monsters (Left Trigger on controller)[/list]

[h1]A New Event Approaches[/h1]
At the end of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tBwN4pZJ9lc]October's Developer Interview[/url], it was mentioned that Power Level Studios might make an appearance at the [url=https://www.facebook.com/MontrealGameSummit/]Montreal International Game Summit[/url]. We love showing off Soul Reaper's animations, and this batch includes a few of our favorites! Check out the Frogginhood and Badnana below!

What an absolutely wicked month we've had! A crafty contest, an insightful developer interview, an awesome playtest event, and to cap it all off, the release of Soul Reaper's Open Beta! Head over to powerlevelstudios.com for the download link, and enjoy!

[h1]The Switch From Early Access to Open Beta[/h1]
There's been a lot of information this month, so much so that you might've missed the recent announcement from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1163660/announcements/detail/1657814577484610493]Monday's Dev Blog[/url]! I highly recommend checking it out if you haven't done so already, but for now, I'll do my best to bring you up to speed!

You may recall that we initially planned to have Soul Reaper available on Steam via Early Access this Halloween. As you might've realized by now, we've instead opted for an Open Beta that's free to download for anyone interested in playing the game early. Why the switch? Well, allow me to explain.

First impressions are everything, [b][i]especially[/i][/b] when your product comes with a price tag. While Soul Reaper already has a lot of amazing content readily accessible in its current form, it's not quite as polished as we'd like it to be. That was the original motivation behind the Early Access period: to allow players to list feedback while improving the game's overall experience.

However, after discussing with a number of playtesters and indie developers alike, we've learned that many players would nowadays consider the Early Access launch of a game as [b][i]the[/i][/b] launch of a game. With this mindset in place, we don't feel that Soul Reaper is at the level of polish that would allow it to shine on a marketplace just yet. A little extra time in the oven would go a long way in nailing a positive, first impression from those who buy it. Hence, the Open Beta!

[h1]Squash Them Bugs[/h1]
Encounter an oddity within your Soul Reaper journey? Want to contribute to the development of the game? Then allow us introduce you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1163660/discussions/0/1696095261009337499/]Soul Reaper's Bug Reporting Form[/url]! The linked thread contains a submission sheet that can be used to notify the developers of a bug you've discovered! We'll be monitoring the feedback we receive quite frequently, and we'll be compiling a list of known issues so you know what to look out for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/bf2f1a03b3fc6c77da827067d0a5d80fb4885014.png[/img][i]Decisions, decisions...[/i]

Typing with a hook and claw isn't exactly easy, so if there are any brave souls out there that would like to flesh out its page over time, you can do so [url=https://www.giantbomb.com/soul-reaper/3030-75829/]here[/url]!)

As pumpkins continue to fill each doorstep, and ghastly decorations litter the streets, it’s no denying that another haunting season is upon us! Power Level Studios has been hard at work making sure Soul Reaper will be ready to rock Early Access this Halloween, and we’ve got even more exciting updates to share with you!

[h1]Paging The Reaper Himself[/h1]
[previewyoutube=tBwN4pZJ9lc;full][/previewyoutube]

The man with the plan, Danny Forest, was once again able to lend his voice for another interview! Given that Soul Reaper’s Early Access is just around the corner, Benign tailored questions to highlight information that newcomers would find greatly beneficial when starting their journey! Timecodes are provided in the video’s description if you’d like to jump to any one question, but I’ll give you a quick sample of what was discussed in the section below!
[list]
[*]Players will traverse Volcanhiem (Hell-like world), Elysium (floating grasslands), Polarus (snow landscape), and The Void (small zone inspired by “The End” in Chrono Trigger).
[*]Type advantages: Fire effective against Earth, Earth effective against Wind, Wind effective against Water, Water effective against Fire. Dark and Light effective against each other. Poison deals DoT, and the Neutral element has no special advantage/weakness.
[*]Stats: Strength buffs physical damage and increases Armor. Intelligence buffs elemental damage. Vitality adds HP. Agility increases attack frequency in combat. Out of all the stats, Forest believes that Agility will be the go-to for new players.
[*]Early Access version has all main content that will be found in the Final version. Final version will have polish, better balancing, and optional quests for the game’s story.
[*]The Midnight Council are the game’s main antagonists, drawing inspiration from the “Sinistrals” in Lufia II. Vipo and Vypo act as Soul Reaper’s assistants throughout the game, and Persie is a blacksmith that functions as the game’s Merchant.
[*]Soul Reaper is sold as a premium game and will not feature microtransactions. No plans for DLC exist at this time.
[*]Loot rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Legendary. Typically, the higher the rarity, the greater number of attributes they can possess. Legendary loot is the exception, as their attributes are already defined (not random).
[*]Loot currently has a 10% chance of dropping from a defeated monster, whereas the game will roll again to determine its rarity.
[*]Souls are more likely to be reaped from higher level enemies. Some loot can also influence the “Soul Find” stat, which greater boosts your chances. System draws inspiration from Castlevania games (Aria/Dawn of Sorrow).
[/list]

Interested in what you see? Check out the full interview for an in-depth look at the above (and more)!

We’ve been paying close attention to player behaviour, and have already noticed several improvements since the event back in September. Many players didn’t know to how initiate combat in September’s build, and only 2 of them actually decided to look at the menus!

[h1]Hello, and welcome to our first announcement post on Steam![/h1]
My name is Benign, and I'm the Community Manager for PLS! I typically write up the Dev Blogs found at [url=medium.com/power-level]medium.com/power-level[/url] and post 'em around the studio's social media accounts. Since this is our first Announcement post under Soul Reaper on Steam, I thought I'd give a little introduction! Pleased to meet you, and I hope I'll be of assistance in the coming months!

I'll get a bug reporting thread up sometime soon in preparation for release, and I'll be posting the Dev Blogs here alongside the usual locations as they roll out! If you ever need to get in touch, feel free to shoot me a message! You can reach me in the [url=https://discord.gg/erupmSD]Community Discord[/url], message me on Steam, or send me a message via the [url=https://www.powerlevelstudios.com/contact]Contact[/url] section on our website!

Anyway, here's the Dev Blog article! If you'd like to read it with its original formatting, please check it out [url=https://medium.com/power-level/full-steam-ahead-all-aboard-the-reap-train-89e62de36b73]here[/url]. Thanks for checking out Soul Reaper, and I hope that you enjoy your stay!

[h1]Full Steam Ahead — All Aboard The Reap Train[/h1]
Power Level Studios is excited to announce that Soul Reaper’s Steam page has been approved! Development has been proceeding quite nicely thanks to our incredible team, and it’s amazing to see how close we are to Early Access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/3a0fdc18ba7d19a2b08018431f6cb224ce487609.png[/img]

Here’s what you can expect from the Early Access build:
[list]
[*]All monsters that are available in the final game will be present in the Early Access build; [*]The three main areas available for exploration in the final game will be accessible in the Early Access build; [*] The main story components available in the final game will be featured in the Early Access build; and [*]All loot pieces that are available in the final game will be present in the Early Access build.
[/list]

That’s a sizeable amount of content for Early Access, huh? You might even be saying, “It sounds like it’s mostly complete, so why Early Access?” Well, I’m glad you asked!

The Early Access period allows us time to polish certain aspects of the game while keeping a keen eye on user feedback. For example, we’ll be assessing what areas require balancing adjustments, adding additional story content, and fixing any bugs that crop up along the way.

With regard to balancing, we’ll be listening attentively to what the community has to say to help adjust the game’s difficulty. Some bosses/areas may not align with the pacing we expect the average player to take, and might need some revaluation should a number of suggestions come in regarding the same thing. Additionally, there’s always the chance that certain loot and monster combinations simply doesn’t yield the expected results (say, if a loot-set bonus isn’t actually being reflected within combat).

Regarding additional story content, there are more story elements we’d like to add in the final game. You’ll still have access to the main plot within Soul Reaper, but the narrative won’t be as fleshed out as it could be. Additionally, dialogue between characters might get spruced up or altered if we feel we can implement something better. Once again, feedback will greatly be appreciated in this area! If there’s a particular interaction between certain characters you’d love to see more of, please let us know!

Finally, there’s the topic of bugs. We’ve been ironing out any oddities that have occurred since [url=https://medium.com/power-level/soul-reaper-local-playtest-and-build-update-ee80185b35e2]September’s Public Playtest[/url] (thanks again to those who attended, it was a great experience!) and have been on a vigilant pursuit ever since. However, we’re always looking at our game with the same pairs of eyes each time. Having non-developers play Soul Reaper will bring fresh perspectives and play-styles… and probably a few “discoveries” that we never stopped to think about! With any new game, there’s always something that the community manages to unveil that surprises the team behind it! If there’s any mind-numbing or world-warping bugs that interfere with your soul reaping experience, then get in touch with us and we’ll have it fixed ASAP!

- - - - - -

[h1]Back in the Spotlight![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/1d9b5ca27b91c79a38641ff1c42eb140ed51f1b3.png[/img]

We’ll be having another public playtest for Soul Reaper later this month! Power Level Studios will be attending Momentum, a networking event in Montreal for influencers and developers alike! We’ll be letting attendees get their hands on the most up to date build of Soul Reaper, so feel free to sign up! Admission is free, but you’ll need to register on the event page in advance, [url=https://www.eventbrite.ca/e/momentum-a-dev-influencer-mingle-by-gps-tickets-66379170887?fbclid=IwAR0RHGRX2pEP_kvFle-7F6P6FZHDSHv9S7KYh6qBEBmYJ_4JAGd8_AX_xoc]here[/url]. We look forward to seeing you there!

- - - - - -

[h1]Paper Figurine to Fit the Halloween Mood![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/df6bd1a993bfe347807656988d28789d3d26714c.png[/img]

Did you know that we have a special printout of the Soul Reaper? Yup! It’s a foldable figurine made by [url=http://www.paperfoldables.com/]paperfoldables.com[/url], and Benign is going to walk us through his very own building process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/d9fdc55fbd2b323d8bd4541f5f3b2f893dacdf4b.jpg[/img]

Pretty cool looking! (I also need to shout-out “Snhex” for adding in the Discord QR code. He’s one of our programmers, and it was quite the welcome addition!)

Alright, let’s get to cutting…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/79d69b2d4caf4c3aebc1419d07ccc85ee653d9da.jpg[/img]

Okay, kinda neat! However, Benign, aren’t you supposed to cut along the lines, and leave out the white…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/47800888733d78b01506e97639c0b7a1a7a1f12c.jpg[/img]

...space?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/ded3af7e30377302b156007657ae8031986a053d.jpg[/img]

Oh, so that’s what it looks like all folded up! But wait, shouldn’t you make sure his body is more… “Closed-up?”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/dc4159631905dda7d278b99ca3545e2b9d9b0838.jpg[/img]

Uh… Things are moving along, I suppose. Let’s see you put that head on straight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/23bcb20d8f3427de6ae1fa9cca2eab52ac06a578.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35969534/22f8e582c582ec64bed1d6bb6ac7e6ef3abf062c.jpg[/img]

Okay, not too bad!

Well, it appears that having a hook for a hand has prevented our very own [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BAxIhSAvD88]Stabbytabby[/url] from making a clean cut. While the attempt looks decent, it can certainly be improved upon.

The question is: [b]Can you do better?[/b]

- - - - - -

[h1]That’s right, it’s time for a CONTEST![/h1]
Do you consider yourself the artsy type? Do you miss the feeling of glue sticks and paper crafts? Would you like to win a Steam key for Soul Reaper? Well, have we got a deal for you!

Power Level Studios will reward a single Steam key to each of the first 5 individuals who produce a better paper figurine using the attached printout. By “better paper figurine,” it simply has to look more presentable that what Benign has produced. Hence, try to get a cleaner cut (leave less white space by cutting along the black lines), and try to prevent white tabs from sticking out (glue or tape the connecting points better than Benign did). The closer your Soul Reaper figurine resembles the stock image provided on the paperfoldables printout, the better!

[b]What you’ll need:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cutting tools. You’ll likely want a pair of scissors for general cutting, but will also need a precision knife to cut the slits into the base of the Soul Reaper’s head. This is how you’ll attach the head to the body. PLEASE BE CAREFUL WHEN USING SHARP OBJECTS, and always ask for permission to use such tools if necessary. [*]Adhesive. When constructing your paper figurine, you can either use glue, or small pieces of double-sided tape. Whatever you find works best! (Benign used glue.) [*]Thick paper. While card stock paper is suggested, as long as you have paper that’s thick enough to allow the Soul Reaper to stand, you should be fine! In the example Benign created, he used “10 Point” card stock paper, “C2S” (Coated both sides). The paper size used was Letter size (8½ by 11 inches). [*]Printer with Ink. We’ll want to see the Soul Reaper with his iconic colour-scheme, so make sure you have enough colour ink for the print. (I wish ink wasn’t so expensive these days… If only I could just buy an octopus.) 
[/list]
[b]How to enter:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Create a figurine of Soul Reaper using the paperfoldables printout. You can download the image [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XoerjYyFZjiNdPGRKLvDmpwBp1ZWeWqw/view]here[/url]. [*]Take a picture of your created figurine stationed somewhere around your gaming setup or desk. He’s a small guy, so feel free to take a close-up. A close picture will also help us judge to see if you made a better model than Benign’s, so it’s definitely preferred! [*]Post your picture to either Twitter or Instagram and @ us in your post. For Twitter, you can use @[url=https://twitter.com/SoulReaperGame1]SoulReaperGame1[/url]. For Instagram, @[url=https://www.instagram.com/powerlevelstudios/]powerlevelstudios[/url]. Online handles and accounts used in association with your submission must be work safe. (We can’t shout-out accounts with NSFW imagery, defamatory names, etc.) [*]Email “contests@powerlevelstudios.com” with the Subject, “Figurine Contest - x” where “x” is your preferred online handle. Within the email, include a link to the social media post containing the photo of your figurine, and list your current Steam username somewhere in the email’s message. [*]Submissions must be sent by 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on Tuesday, October 29th, 2019.
[/olist]
[b]Determining the 5 winners:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Power Level Studios will assess each submission in chronological order to determine if the submitted paper figurine appears better than Benign’s. To define “better,” we’re looking for a Soul Reaper figurine that has a cleaner cut along the black lines, and is sealed to prevent white tabs from sticking out. [*]The first 5 individuals to submit figurines that surpass Benign’s will be declared the winners. Hence, you don’t need to waste time trying to be perfect! It simply needs to be better than Benign’s. [*]Winners will be decided no later than 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on Monday, November 4th, 2019. Winners will be notified via the email address they used to submit their entry. [*]Steam keys will be issued to the supplied email address before 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on Tuesday, November 29th, 2019.
[/olist]

Whew, that was a lot of writing! Well, I hope you folks have fun with this! It was pretty neat breaking out the old glue stick that somehow still works from high school… Oh, and be careful not to get any paper cuts!
